name: Codex Discipline
legend: Deployed as a mutually supportive strike force that epitomises the flexibility and martial wisdom of the Codex Astartes, Space Marines have the answer to any strategic or tactical challenge.
description: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Ironstorm Auto-targeters
legend: Space Marine armoured formations rapidly share cogitated targeting data to augment their already superb marksmanship and reaction times.
description:
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units’ (excluding walker units) ranged attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.

name: Lightning-fast Strike
legend: Racing into battle at breakneck speeds, Space Marine fast-attack squadrons often punch into the enemy lines before the foe even realises their peril.
description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +2" M.

name: Mission Tactics
legend: Thousands of years of collated strategic data and hard-won combat experience have provided the Deathwatch with the ultimate battlefield tactics to combat almost any foe.

name: Vowed Target
legend: Whether its true significance is kept a secret or not, there is a singular prize here that the Inner Circle have come to either secure or destroy. They will pursue this strategic objective with cold ferocity.
description:
In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one objective. That objective is your vowed objective until your next Command phase.
  • Friendly Deathwing Infantry unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have +1 to wound rolls.

Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Drive Home the Blade
legend: The Adeptus Astartes launch their shipboard strikes with precision and lethal momentum, sweeping aside each new obstruct ion to their progress and pressing ever forward.
description: Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to shoot, if one or more models from that unit are within 1" of an open Hatchway and every model in that unit is on the same side of that Hatchway, select one enemy unit on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [sustained hits 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.

name: Relentless Salvoes
legend: These vanguard specialists stay on the move, laying down hails of fire to harass and disrupt their foes even as they hit-and-fade through chambers and corridors.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Sacred Oath
legend: Space Marine Chapters do not lightly commit their precious suits of Terminator armour to battle, nor the storied veterans who wear them. When they go to war, they always do so with a vital duty and a crucial target.
description: Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, when you select a target for Oath of Moment, you can use this Detachment rule. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets your Oath of Moment target, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

name: Legacy of the Angel
legend: Never do the Blood Angels stand taller or strive harder than when faced with seemingly impossible odds. At such times, the Sons of Sanguinius delve deep into their souls for preternatural reserves of determination, fury and focus. Sometimes, they even touch upon the uncertain gift of prophecy that was said to be their gene‑sire’s boon and his curse.
description:
Friendly Blood Angels Character units:
  • Can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: The Great Wolf Watches
legend: The battle‑brothers of this Great Company know what their lord expects of them and stand ready to pounce the moment the foe are fool enough to stray within range.
description:
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Character units have the following ability:

Countercharge: (Once per battle round, per unit) When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1CP.

name: Dutiful Tenacity
legend: Even amongst the Adeptus Astartes, the battle‑brothers of the Dark Angels are renowned for their tenacity and resilience on the battlefield. When ordered to war, they are utterly relentless in pursuing their objectives, wading into fields of withering fire and shrugging off blows that would slay mortal warriors outright.
description:
Attacks that target friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted units with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Legendary Slayers
legend: Some Space Wolves seek only to bring down the most monstrous and deadly foes. With hunting packs of Fenrisian wolves, Thunderwolf Cavalry and rampaging bands of Wulfen, they seek to hunt down and slay mighty champions, towering monstrosities and rumbling war machines, demoralising the foe and earning glorious victories.
description: Attacks made by friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen units have [Lethal Hits: Character/Monster/Vehicle].

name: Vulkan's Quest
legend: Tireless in his pursuit of the Primarch’s legacy, Forgefather Vulkan He’stan annihilates any who impede his quest. Favouring swift, aggressive assaults, he and his warriors close rapidly with the enemy, destroying them at close range with ruthless efficiency
description:
• You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.
  • Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units’ ranged attacks that target a unit within 12", have +1 S.

If your army includes a Vulkan He’stan unit, friendly Infernus Squad units have the following:
  • When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that advance/fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.
  • When this unit starts an action, that action does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

Restrictions: Your army can include Salamanders units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Shadow Tactics
legend: The Raven Guard are renowned for their uncanny ability to move unseen, cloaking themselves in darkness as they close in upon their prey. Aethon Shaan is a true master at harnessing these abilities, withdrawing and redeploying his battle-brothers to draw the enemy out of formation.
description:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have Stealth.

Friendly Phobos/Scout Squad units have -3" detection range.

Friendly Aethon Shaan units have the following ability:

Unparalleled Tactician: (Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Into Darkness stratagem, that use is -1CP.

name: Storm-swift Onslaught
legend: The White Scars are masters of high‑speed tactics and hit‑and‑run warfare. They do battle on the move and from the saddle, outwitting their enemies with breakneck manoeuvres and melting away one moment only to crash home with bone‑crushing force the next.
description:
• You can select the assault doctrine or tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.
  • Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +1 to advance rolls.

Friendly Suboden Khan units have the following ability:

Wrath of the First Khan: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was eligible to fight this phase, you can use this ability. If you do:
  • If this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move.
  • Or: If this unit is engaged, this unit can make a fall-back move.

Restrictions: Your army can include White Scars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Mastered Doctrines
legend: Marneus Calgar deploys the complete and nuanced wisdom of the Codex Astartes as easily and instinctively as drawing breath.
description: If your army includes a Marneus Calgar unit, you can select the assault doctrine/devastator doctrine/tactical doctrine each one additional time per battle.

name: Master of Wolves
legend: When the Great Wolf Logan Grimnar leads his packs to war, it is certain that mighty deeds will be done and epic verses added to the sagas of many a Space Wolf. There is none amongst the sons of Russ who can command such instinctive authority throughout his Chapter, none who so deftly wields warrior and war engine like a single great pack. In the sight of their lord, every Space Wolf aspires to be a champion of Fenris and strives with ever-greater determination to prove themselves worthy of his regard. Grimnar masterfully directs the hunt from its very heart, orchestrating every element like an apex predator herding its prey to destruction. Where restraint is needed, he sees it exercised. Where focused fury must be unleashed, he is its master and embodiment both. So does the saga of Logan Grimnar grow ever greater for the telling.

name: Focused Response
legend: The battle-brothers of the Shield Chapters commit their boarding strikes with a measured and meticulous application of force. They storm one section after the next while maintaining heightened awareness of lurking threats, and readying themselves to launch devastating counterattacks.
description:
• Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
  • Each time an enemy unit makes an attack that targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is Set To Defend, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

name: Adaptive Defence
legend: These Space Marines are experts in fighting from rapidly prepared defensive positions. They are able to maximise the potential of almost any terrain to serve as an ad-hoc strongpoint, rapidly assessing optimal firing lines and punishing the foe’s every attempt to advance and dislodge them.
description:
• While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within a terrain area, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units are entrenched while all of the following apply:
    • That unit is within a terrain area.
    • That unit was not set up this turn.
    • No model in that unit moved more than 3" this turn.

  • Friendly Darnath Lysander/Tor Garadon units have the following ability:
Defensive Mastery: At the start of each phase, this unit is entrenched.

DARNATH LYSANDER’s/TOR GARADON’s unit is always entrenched, regardless of the conditions listed above.

Restrictions: Your army can include Imperial Fists units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Faith-fuelled Resolve
legend: Uncompromising in their faith, a crusade's Sword Brethren are blazing beacons of intolerant resolve capable of holding back hordes of blasphemous foes from sites sacred to the Black Templars.
description:
In the Fight phase, if a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit is within range of an objective, that unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.

Restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Wrath of Angels
legend: Few living warriors embody the ideal of the Emperor's wrathful angels more than the Sanguinary Guard, for they appear without warning to wreak death and destruction before surging on to the next foe with shocking speed.
description:
The tactical doctrine is active for Sanguinary Guard units in addition to any other combat doctrine.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Sanguinius' Fury
legend: Swept up in visions of the Primarch’s blood-drenched final hours, the Lost throw themselves upon the foe, channelling the Great Angel’s fury and striving their utmost to emulate his mastery of close-quarters combat.
description:
Friendly DEATH COMPANY units have the following:
  • At the start of each phase, the assault doctrine is active for this unit.
  • The devastator/tactical doctrine cannot be active for this unit.
This means that, regardless of any other rules, DEATH COMPANY units can never have an active doctrine other than the assault doctrine.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Black-winged Vigilance
legend: The anti-grav skimmers and combat aircraft of the Ravenwing bristle not only with potent weapons but also with powerful augurs and trackers, whose sleepless machine spirits are as vigilant as the black-armoured battle-brothers.
description:
Friendly Ravenwing Fly units’ ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Friendly Outrider squad units have BATTLELINE.

Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Mission Tactics
legend: Thousands of years of collated strategic data and hard-won combat experience have provided the Deathwatch with the ultimate battlefield tactics to combat almost any foe.
description:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:

Furor Tactics

When the enemy horde grows close, the Deathwatch will be tasked with the decimation of their core. Aiming not for clinical kills but for maximum destruction over a wide area, they tear the heart from the enemy army.

If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Malleus Tactics

When the giants of war lumber forth, the Deathwatch will adopt Malleus tactics. Even the largest behemoth has a weak point, and the archives of the Deathwatch number them all.

If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Purgatus Tactics

By adopting Purgatus tactics, the Deathwatch focus their deadly ire upon the commanders of the enemy host, assassinating them one after another with pitiless head shots and killing thrusts of the blade.

If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].

DEATHWATCH ALLIES
You can include Deathwatch units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.

When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a DEATHWATCH model to be your WARLORD. In addition KILL TEAM units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.

This an exception to the Space Marine Chapters Army Rules.

name: Templar Vows
legend: On the eve of battle, the Black Templars gather to be led in prayer and contemplation by their champions. United in their hatred of the foe, they swear a mighty vow to uphold in the battle ahead.
description:
At the start of the first battle round, you can select one Vow listed below. That Vow is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units until the end of the battle.

Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch
This unit’s melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit:
  • Have [PRECISION].
  • Have [LANCE].

Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds
Friendly melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than this unit’s S have +1 to wound rolls.

Uphold the Honour of the Emperor
Friendly INFANTRY units have:
  • At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.
  • When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

Restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Purge and Sanctify
legend: As the battle-brothers of a Vindication Task Force purge the Emperor’s domain in fire and blood, they see their holy quest as recovering Humanity’s rightful dominion. They scour the stain of the unclean, topple false idols, breach strongholds of unholy faith and plant the crusade’s standards in their place, branding such sites with the sacred icons of their brotherhood.
description:
Each time a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit makes a surge move, instead of selecting a surge target, you can select the closest objective to that unit. When that unit makes that surge move, each model in that unit must end that surge move as close as possible to that objective instead.

Restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Armoured Wrath
description:
Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:
  • If that unit is within 6" of a friendly Cannok Var/Iron Father Feirros unit you can:
    • Re-roll one hit roll.
    • Re-roll one wound roll.
    • Re-roll one damage roll.
  • Otherwise you can:
    • Re-roll one hit roll.
    • Or: Re-roll one wound roll.
    • Or: Re-roll one damage roll.

name: Combined Deployment
legend: Space Marine crews train to provide armoured fire support to their debarked passengers while on the attack.
description:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn:
  • While a unit is assailed, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Shadow Masters
legend: Holding to the shadows and choosing victims with care, Phobos-armoured Astartes winnow the enemy ranks without ever revealing their positions.
description:
When a friendly Phobos or Scout SQUAD unit has shot:
  • Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.
  • Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

name: Wrath of the Chapter
legend: When the Space Marines are roused to true martial fury, they bring their vengeance to their adversaries with the inescapable speed of a lightning strike.
description: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

name: Vanguard Ambushers
legend: Few experiences are so terrifying for Mankind’s enemies as finding themselves the victims of Phobos-armoured ambushers.
description: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

name: Death Blow
legend: Veterans of a hundred decapitating strikes, these First Company warriors know that if they land their first blow with sufficiently furious momentum, they will need no second.
description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.

name: Assault Mastery
legend: Space Marines who specialise in close-quarters brutality truly embody their sobriquet ‘Angels of Death’.
description: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Walking Fortress
legend: With their plan in motion and targets designated, Gravis-armoured warriors stride unstoppably into battle as they lay down withering hails of firepower.
description:
In a turn a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, that unit’s ranged attacks:
  • Do not have [Heavy].
  • Have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Devastator Mastery
legend: Unceasing and unmerciful, Adeptus Astartes fire support formations lay waste to all that falls under their gunsights.
description: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Indomitable Defence
legend: The Adeptus Astartes stand as an adamantine wall against any who would assail the Emperor’s realm.
description: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

name: Tactical Mastery
legend: Rarely are the Adeptus Astartes deadlier than when they bring to bear the most fundamental teachings of the Codex Astartes.
description: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Enduring Vengeance
legend: Those who pilot Dreadnoughts combine the skill of undying champions with a cold and vengeful hatred of the Emperor’s countless enemies.
description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Codex Fire-patterns
legend: Faced with multiple threats that must be efficiently eliminated, the Space Marines employ time-honoured ballistic doctrines to great effect.
description: Friendly Tacticus units’ [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.
